about: Spoken audio for the Agent Flow promo. render.mjs places each segment at its start time, times the scene from it and writes the captions. promo/README.md explains every field.

voice.speaker: One natural-sounding synthetic female voice for every segment. Never the macOS say command or another robotic voice.
voice.narration: Warm, relaxed and conversational, like showing a friend something you use every day. Quietly impressed on the first line, never salesy or shouty.
voice.dictation: The same voice dictating to her Mac: casual, natural, a little quieter, as if thinking aloud.
voice.accent: British English preferred; any clear, natural English accent is fine.
voice.pace: Unhurried, about 150 words per minute, with a short natural pause at each full stop.
voice.files: One speech-only file per segment, named <id>.wav (44.1 or 48 kHz, mono or stereo). No music, effects or processing.

segments.text: Wow. This is the future of speech to text.
segments.picture: Title card: Agent Flow, Speech to text, with your highlights and screenshots.

segments.text: Press your shortcut and just talk.
segments.picture: Mac desktop. The recorder rises above the Dock.
Each word appears live in the recorder as she says it.

segments.text: Highlight the code you mean, no copying needed.
segments.picture: The pointer drags across a function in TextEdit; a Selected Text reference joins the live words.

segments.text: and make the empty state look like this.
segments.picture: More live words in the recorder.

segments.text: Take a screenshot to show what you want.
segments.picture: A screenshot of the design window; a Screenshot reference joins the live words.

segments.text: Press again, and Agent Flow pastes it all in one go, so your agent can see what you were looking at.
segments.picture: Stop. The words, the selection and the screenshot path paste into Codex together.

segments.text: Agent Flow. Open source, for Mac.
segments.picture: End card with the download link.
